title: Oracle Database CDC source connector for Fabric Eventstream (Preview)

content.text: The Oracle Database CDC source connector for Eventstream (Preview) streams changes from an Oracle database into Fabric as a structured change event with before and after values, using Oracle LogMiner for on-premises or cloud databases running Oracle 12c and later. For more information, see Add Oracle Database CDC source to an eventstream (preview).
